consumer: The frontend inventory panel, asking 'what top-level items does the GUI's inventory screen display for the player?'
scope: The player-facing, top-level formatted/filtered inventory view (stacked, collapsed, container-contents-hidden) as the inventory screen would render it
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items walks raw ctx.u.wielded_items()/worn/inv_const_slice() and emits flat per-item raw fields, bypassing any inventory-display formatting/stacking/filtering
divergence: Player holds a backpack containing 5 items and two identical canteens: the raw dump lists the backpack plus inner items flat and both canteens separately, while the inventory screen displays the backpack as one collapsed top-level entry and stacks the canteens as a single line — the panel mismatches
